decisions.reason: As the flagship product central to the firm's announced direction, dropping it would write off highly visible investment and expose management to public failure.
Its dedicated website page and multiple models signal public commitment and substantial development effort, favoring persistence despite any early disappointments.
Only briefly mentioned on the website, it has less visible commitment, giving a somewhat higher drop probability, but early results can still be attributed to temporary causes, so it is kept.
Like product C, it lacks a dedicated page and thus has lower public commitment, but the product line investment and short time on market make dropping premature.
With its own website page and a product line, the firm has committed publicly and invested across models, making near-term dropping unlikely.
Its dedicated website page represents public commitment that management would need to justify abandoning, and early results can be explained by temporary factors.
